title: Does Emergent Misalignment Scale With Model Parameter Count in a Predictable Way?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Scaling laws for misalignment would allow extrapolation to frontier models. If predictable, this directly informs risk assessment for models of any size. Extremely high practical value for policy and technical safety.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires finetuning 5 models of increasing size (up to 14B). The 7B and 14B models require significant GPU memory that may exceed medium compute. Managing matched training across very different model sizes is non-trivial.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Five separate finetuning runs on models from 0.5B to 14B. Larger models take substantially more time. Even with medium compute, the 14B model may not be feasible. Could be narrowed to 3 sizes but as stated, scope is broad.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
